# mailgun_subaccounts (Data Source)

Use this data source to list all Mailgun subaccounts. Subaccounts are child accounts that share the same plan as the primary account but have their own domains, users, and settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Filter to only return enabled subaccounts. If not set, returns all subaccounts.

### Read-Only

- `subaccounts` (Attributes List) List of subaccounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subaccounts))
- `total_count` (Number) The total number of subaccounts returned.

<a id="nestedatt--subaccounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subaccounts`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the subaccount.
- `name` (String) The name of the subaccount.
- `status` (String) The status of the subaccount: 'enabled' or 'disabled'.
